title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
authors: Yongtong Wu; Shaoyuan Chen; Yinmin Zhong; Rilin Huang; Yixuan Tan; Wentao Zhang; Liyue Zhang; Shangyan Zhou; Yuxuan Liu; Shunfeng Zhou; Mingxing Zhang; Xin Jin; Panpan Huang

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM inference is bottlenecked by storage I/O imbalance in disaggregated architectures, where prefill engines are bandwidth-saturated while decoding engines remain idle. This leads to severe GPU underutilization during KV-Cache loading.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM inference 在解耦架構中受制於儲存 I/O 失衡：prefill 引擎頻寬飽和，而 decoding 引擎卻閒置，導致 KV cache 載入期間 GPU 嚴重低利用。

key_innovation.en: DualPath introduces a dual-path KV-Cache loading architecture that enables loading KV-Cache into decoding engines and transferring it to prefill engines via RDMA, combined with a workload-aware scheduler to balance network and compute resources.
key_innovation.zh: DualPath 引入雙路徑 KV cache 載入架構：將 KV cache 載入 decoding 引擎後再透過 RDMA 傳輸至 prefill 引擎，並搭配感知工作負載的 scheduler 以平衡網路與計算資源。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: SGLang (with HiCache and Mooncake), Basic (unmodified internal framework), Oracle

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.87x offline inference throughput increase and 1.96x average online serving throughput improvement.
key_improvements.zh: 離線 inference 吞吐量最高提升 1.87x，線上 serving 平均吞吐量提升 1.96x。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: Agentic LLM Inference, LLM Serving, RL Training Rollout
workload_and_traffic.traffic_pattern: AllToAll, ReduceScatter, AllGather, RDMA, KV-Cache transfer

networking_stack.routing_and_congestion_control: Virtual Lanes (VL), Weighted Round Robin (WRR), PFC
